column2: don't run apm_ops.init() until needed at ""up"" time.

column1: EEPROM (5000 and earlier devices) may be read without running apm_ops.init()
but OTP reads (6000 and newer devices) require a powered-up chip.

column2: remove apm_ops.init() from the general path in XXXX_pci_probe()

column1: and call it only if device uses OTP.  Once done with OTP read
apm_ops.stop() to reset chip and save power until ""up"" time comes around.
NOTE:  This patch depends on removal of priv->lock from iwl_apm_stop();
lock does not get initialized until later in flow.  See patch
